name: advisors-excel-react-challenge
description: Root workspace runner for API and UI services

scripts.dev: docker compose rm -sf api-dev ui-dev && docker compose up --build db api-dev ui-dev
scripts.dev:up: docker compose rm -sf api-dev ui-dev && docker compose up -d --build db api-dev ui-dev
scripts.dev:logs: docker compose logs --tail 100 -f db api-dev ui-dev
scripts.dev:down: docker compose rm -sf api-dev ui-dev && docker compose stop db
scripts.test:docker: docker compose run --rm --build api-test && docker compose run --rm --build ui-test
scripts.test:docker:coverage: docker compose run --rm --build api-test npm test -- --coverage && docker compose run --rm --build ui-test npm test -- --coverage --watchAll=false
scripts.ci: npm run test:docker && docker compose build api ui
scripts.test:local: npm test --prefix api && npm test --prefix ui -- --watchAll=false
